text:
sec-alert-bot: :rotating_light: SECURITY: High-volume leak detected. ~2k occurrences of raw Authorization headers indexed in external ES cluster 'logs-prod-external' by forwarder instance log-forwarder-3. Possible PII/auth token exposure. Paging @eric-oncall @maria-sre @jen-security. Trigger time 5239997777.
eric-oncall: On it. Can someone confirm whether these are full bearer tokens or truncated debug strings?
sec-alert-bot: Sample from the index (scrubbed):
```
"timestamp":"2024-06-01T03:12:43Z","service":"api-gateway","request":"GET /v1/generate","headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer sk_live_eyJhbGci...J9.signed-part"}
```
maria-sre: pausing log-forwarder-3 in us-west-2 now. disabling its IAM key immediately. applying egress block to 34.120.45.23 (external ES IP) at the VPC firewall. :white_check_mark:
jen-security: good. Start key rotation for service account log-forwarder-sa. Create new key, push to forwarder config, verify no errors, then revoke old key. I will kick off the rotation and own coordination with legal if confirmed tokens map to customers.
sam-platform: deploying a temporary request-munging WAF rule to strip Authorization headers from any outgoing logs on the forwarder path. Also adding deny rule for outbound 9200/443 to known external ES endpoints.
eric-oncall: Maria — any sign that forwarded logs include refresh tokens or only access tokens? That's higher-impact.
maria-sre: quick grep shows some Authorization headers include 'Bearer rtk_' prefix and others 'Bearer sk_'. Could be mix of short-lived access and refresh. We'll assume worst-case until audit completes.
amanda-cs: prepping a holding statement for customers — please tag me when we know scope. Will need list of affected customers and whether tokens were active.
jen-security: doing immediate audit of logs by tracing token IDs against access logs. If tokens are active we'll revoke sessions for affected customers. Legal, please standby: @legal.
ops-bot: rotation job queued: rotate_key --svc=log-forwarder-sa --env=prod --notify=@jen-security,@maria-sre. Job id 7723.
sam-platform: running discovery to list which indices in external ES contain our project prefix:
```
# curl -s -u readonly:**** https://34.120.45.23:9200/_cat/indices?v | grep logs-prod
logs-prod-external-2024.06.01  open  5  1   2400  120GB
```
jen-security: timeline note: first occurrence at ~5239997600, forwarder spike 5239997700-5239997800. We'll force rotate at 5239998200 and then monitor for failed auth attempts.
eric-oncall: Immediate mitigations checklist (doing):
- [x] pause forwarder instance (maria)
- [x] block egress to external ES (maria)
- [x] queue key rotation (jen/ops-bot)
- [ ] verify which tokens were active (jen)
- [ ] notify affected customers (amanda/legal)
- [ ] rotate any exposed service account keys and update deploys (sam)
- [ ] create incident bridge + postmortem (eric -> will own)
jen-security: I see rotation job started and new key provisioning succeeded on one replica. Will sequentially update the rest, confirm ingest resumes without old key.
maria-sre: searching internal index for correlated requests to find potentially affected customers; dumping results to secure bucket (access limited).
legal: standby for scope. If refresh tokens confirmed, we will need to evaluate breach notification timelines and coordinate with compliance. Please keep preservation of evidence intact.
amanda-cs: prepping customer outreach templates; ETA 1.5h once we have list and impact classification.
ops-bot: key-rotate job 7723: step 1 done, step 2 rolling update queued, expected complete in ~10m.
jen-security: after rotation we'll revoke the old key and publish a revocation note to IAM history. Everyone avoid making mass reconfigs until rotation completes.
lee-oncall: incoming handoff at 5239998099. I'll take post-rotation verification and run the access log cross-check overnight. Please DM me any outstanding artifacts.
eric-oncall: handing to @lee-oncall for overnight verification. I'll own the incident postmortem and timeline tomorrow AM. Good job triaging quickly. Keep thread updated with final rotation/time of revocation and customer list. :thumbsup:
sec-alert-bot: Alert suppressed now; monitor rule continues and will repost if additional anomalies detected.
